blocks.text: # ProofPress for Notion — internal adapter strategy
## Decision

Explore a narrow private Notion adapter before committing to a public API,
Marketplace listing, or partnership request. This is a product strategy, not a
public ProofPress protocol commitment.

> Notion manages collaborative page evolution. ProofPress records which
> revisions and decisions were explicitly admitted, on what evidence, by whom,
> and whether they still verify independently.
## Product boundary

Notion version history is useful for recovery and collaboration, but it is not
a portable, claim-level record of accepted evidence and downstream reliance.
ProofPress must not claim to replace Notion history or to capture every edit.
It is an explicit admission and verification layer at meaningful checkpoints.
## Intended user flow

1. A person or approved agent edits a Notion page normally.
2. At a semantic checkpoint, they choose **Admit with ProofPress**, or an
approved workflow invokes the equivalent action.
3. The adapter fetches the current authorized page representation and creates
a candidate revision.
4. The actor supplies concise claims and attribution. No raw prompt or session
transcript is captured.

5. ProofPress snapshots and verifies the admitted carrier.
6. Notion receives a compact status block with revision, verifier state, and a
link to the portable ProofPress record.
Do not snapshot every keystroke, webhook, or conversational turn.
## Adapter architecture

```text
Notion edit or explicit admission
  -> webhook signal / action
  -> fetch page Markdown and block structure
  -> canonicalize into a deterministic carrier
  -> capture + claims + attributed snapshot + verify
  -> immutable portable ledger and content hash
  -> Notion status projection and verification link
```

Notion remains the authoring source of truth. The portable ProofPress ledger
and content hash are the source of truth for an admitted revision. The Notion
status block is only a projection, never the sole verification record.
## Identity and consistency

Retain page ID, parent context, block IDs where available, fetch time, content
hash, and optional Notion revision metadata. A webhook is only a signal: fetch
the latest authorized content, reconcile by hash, and handle duplicate or
reordered deliveries idempotently.

Derive ProofPress anchors from stable Notion block identity where available plus
a canonicalized carrier. Moves, splits, merges, or unsupported blocks must
produce a new revision or fail admission explicitly; they must not be silently
dropped. Keep the Notion-block-to-ProofPress-anchor mapping as audit metadata,
not hidden page text.
## Privacy and safety rules

- Use OAuth or an internal integration with least-privilege page access.
- Scope each connection to an explicit page, folder, or database.
- Do not ingest workspace-wide content, unrelated child pages, credentials,
raw agent transcripts, or hidden memory by default.

- Support redaction or content-hash-only mode for sensitive pilots.
- Verify webhook signatures and idempotency before acting.
- Display pending, failed, and verified states honestly; never infer
authorship, rationale, or verification success.
## MVP and non-goals

The first pilot supports one selected page or database record, explicit manual
admission, canonicalization, ProofPress snapshot/verify, a portable export,
and a compact Notion status block.

It does not continuously surveil a workspace, replace Notion history/comments/
permissions, automatically generate claims without attribution, alter Notion
database schemas, or treat Notion AI output as trusted by origin alone.
## Pilot hypotheses and PR gate

Use five to ten high-consequence examples: research decisions, diligence
memos, customer-facing operations, policy handoffs, and agent-produced plans.
The pilot must let participants answer more reliably which revision was
accepted, what evidence supported it, who recorded it, and whether it verifies
without Notion access.
Open an implementation PR only after these are frozen:
## Notion relationship

Build a working adapter and collect pilot evidence before approaching Notion.
The eventual pitch is complementary: Notion owns collaborative authoring;
ProofPress makes high-stakes human and agent decisions portable and
independently checkable. The useful ask is a native admission entry point or
richer revision/block metadata, not access to every workspace revision.
## Revisit trigger

Revisit this strategy when the first pilot artifact type and privacy posture
are chosen. Do not start implementation until the scope, identity mapping,
failure behavior, and fixtures are agreed.
